decisions.reason: A consumer superfood drink mix draws little on the firm's engineering and waste-conversion knowledge, so it has weak absorptive capacity to interpret market feedback and improve the product, and the resources are better redirected to its core technologies.
Modular waste-to-energy extensions build directly on the firm's in-house engineering, automation and prototyping expertise, letting it learn from deployments and refine the models.
The WASTX Oil plant is a flagship grounded in the firm's core decentralized waste-to-energy know-how, where its R&D team can assimilate early results and improve the technology.

Plastic-to-fuel conversion is closely related to the firm's waste-oil and pyrolysis-type technologies, so its existing knowledge base supports continued development despite technical and market uncertainty.
